formula: plays × dropback rate × expected QB share × attempts/dropback
required_comparators: V1/Phase1C analytic/frozen opportunity on same cohort (never simulate; unavailable is explicit)
recent3 team plays × recent3 dropback rate × prior share × prior conversion
frozen Week4 workload3 × efficiency8 opportunity component

rules.conversion: last5 QB across-team attempts/dropbacks, 50 prior league dropbacks
rules.dropback_rate: last3 current-team sum dropbacks / sum plays, 100 league prior plays
rules.league: strict prior most recent128 team-games, no target week
rules.plays: last3 current-team mean plays, two league prior games
rules.share: accepted expected QB only; last3 current-team QB dropbacks / team dropbacks, 20 prior dropbacks at share1 for an explicit single starter; no guessed assignment
